typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveVendorResults as string (),
	RecordsStaged as integer (),
	ResultsEmailRecipients as string (),
	StagedRows as integer (),
	StartDateTime as timestamp (),
	Variable1 as integer (),
	Vendor as string (),
	VendorFileName as string (),
	VendorFileNamePfx as string (),
	VendorFilePath as string (),
	VendorFilePathName as string (),
	Vendor_variable as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Appointment Date} as string,
		{Appointment Time} as string,
		{Client's Last Name} as string,
		{Client’s First Name} as string,
		{Home Phone Number} as string,
		{Message Number} as string,
		{Call Status Description} as string,
		{Contacted Date} as string,
		{Contacted Time} as string,
		{Message Description} as string,
		{HouseCalls Client Number} as string,
		{Client's Nick Name} as string,
		{Client's Reference Number from Import} as string,
		{Call Status Code} as string,
		{Provider Number} as string,
		{Provider Name} as string,
		{Location Number} as string,
		{Location Name} as string,
		{Reason Number} as string,
		{Reason Name} as string,
		{Appointment Notes} as string,
		{Appointment Column} as string,
		{Client's Social Security Number} as string,
		{Client's Birth Date} as string,
		{Client Notes} as string,
		{Number of Call Attempts} as string,
		{Client Address} as string,
		{Client City} as string,
		{Client State} as string,
		{Client Zip} as string,
		{Email Address} as string,
		{Email Status} as string,
		{Emailed Date} as string,
		{Emailed Time} as string,
		{SMS Phone} as string,
		{SMS Status} as string,
		{SMS Delivered Date} as string,
		{SMS Delivered Time} as string,
		Duration as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> VendorResultsFile
VendorResultsFile split(toString(Client's Reference Number from Import) != toString('RECORD_ID'), disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Case1 derive(CALLED_PHONE = toString(replace(replace(replace({Home Phone Number}, toString('('), toString('')), toString(')'), toString('')), toString('-'), toString(''))),
		CALLTIME = iif({Contacted Date} == '', toTimestamp(null()), toTimestamp(toString((toString(({Contacted Date} + ' ' + {Contacted Time}))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy')),
		UPDATED_PHONE = toString(replace(replace(replace({Home Phone Number}, toString('('), toString('')), toString(')'), toString('')), toString('-'), toString(''))),
		RECORD_ID = toString({Client's Reference Number from Import}),
		CELLPHONE = toString({SMS Phone}),
		GATHERED_EMAIL = toString({Email Address}),
		CALL_RESULT = toString({Call Status Description}),
		SURVEY_ID = toString('TL9999'),
		Vendor = toString('Televox')) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		CALLED_PHONE as string,
		CELLPHONE as string,
		CALLTIME as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CALL_RESULT as string,
		UPDATED_PHONE as string,
		GATHERED_EMAIL as string,
		RECORD_ID as long,
		SURVEY_ID as string,
		Vendor as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CALLED_PHONE,
		CELLPHONE,
		CALLTIME,
		CALL_RESULT,
		UPDATED_PHONE,
		GATHERED_EMAIL,
		RECORD_ID,
		SURVEY_ID,
		Vendor)) ~> OLEDBDestination
